# deskl.ink — Complete Knowledge Corpus

> A desktop for you. A computer for your AI. Instantly available, browser-accessible Linux workstations operable by a human, an AI agent, many cooperating agents, or a human and AI together. Cloudflare-native — a workstation boots in seconds and scales to zero when idle.

Cloudflare-native: each live desktop is a container-enabled Durable Object; it boots in seconds and scales to zero when idle.
A standalone product that owns its own workstation runtime, UI, and agent-control plane — not a plugin of another app.
Built to be operated by AI as a first-class user, not only by humans, through the same control plane.

## Product

### Cloud Linux workstations in your browser
Source: https://deskl.ink/

## Cloud Linux workstations in your browser

deskl.ink gives you cloud Linux workstations (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian) in your browser — no local install, no infrastructure to configure.

- **Sizes:** Everyday (4 GiB) · Developer (6) · Power (8) · Heavy (12).
- **Forms:** a **Desktop** (full graphical environment streamed over VNC) or a headless **Server** (terminal-native — git, Node, Python, ripgrep, tmux, and a browser terminal).
- Every open computer is a tab in one workspace; a ⌘K command palette, inline rename, live cost estimates, and a one-click “stop everything running” keep it fast.
- Installable as an app, and the shell works offline.
- Built to be operated by people and by AI agents through the same control plane.

## For AI agents

### Agent-operable control plane
Source: https://deskl.ink/

## Agent-operable control plane

deskl.ink is built to be operated by AI as a first-class user, not only by humans. A single desktop can be driven by a human, one AI agent, many cooperating agents, or a human and AI together.

It is a standalone product that owns its own workstation runtime, UI, and agent-control plane — not a plugin of another app.
